audit_pass.summary: spec binding enforced on all CLI run/eval agent construction, codec translation losses declared and reported, E501 lint activated, dead code removed, grading/doctor/probe extracted from the CLI, shared checkout/hash/lifecycle helpers deduplicated, SWE-bench grader inventory count and byte totals asserted; the OSS pass added provider retry/backoff, bounded screenshot replay, credential preflight, the swe workspace guard, eval progress output, the quickstart/examples/library documentation, and the multi-mini-agent companion distribution; a later pass added the pinned ProgramBench adapter and flattened validation boilerplate onto shared type validators (src/mini_agent 20,902 -> 19,430 lines) with fingerprints, public API, and byte-exact upstream literals verified unchanged; a further pass extracted the benchmark-neutral runtimes/ layer (local, docker, apptainer) with one bash environment over it, replaced the embedded Docker grader probe with in-process verification, and moved the storage and content-identity primitives out of benchmarks/base.py into storage.py and _hash.py — fixing a latent directory_sha256 regression the suite did not catch, now pinned by tests/test_digest_stability.py
